description: Small reproducible runnable fixture seeds derived from demo profiles, not clones of published repositories. Each seed has an intentional defect and an independent acceptance script. Fake execution remains simulated.

tasks.title: Check query-parser round trips
tasks.instructions: Add generated query cases covering quoting, escaped delimiters and empty filters. Assert parse/serialize/parse preserves the query AST without changing accepted syntax.
acceptanceCriteria: Quoted delimiters and escaping round trip
Malformed input is rejected without throwing outside the parser error contract
tasks.verification: Run the harness's independent Node acceptance tests for the percent-encoded key/value query grammar. Preserve the parseQuery and serializeQuery exports.

tasks.title: Verify balanced ledger postings
tasks.instructions: Add tests that balanced entries preserve debit/credit equality and unbalanced entries leave the ledger unchanged. Cover zero values, multiple lines and integer minor-unit boundaries.
acceptanceCriteria: Rejected postings have no partial side effects
tasks.verification: Run the harness's independent Node posting acceptance tests. Keep post(ledger, entries), using integer minor units and debit/credit line objects.

tasks.title: Verify speculative decoding equivalence
tasks.instructions: Use deterministic stub draft and target models to test accepted and rejected speculative tokens, end-of-sequence handling and target fallback. Do not fetch model weights or contact inference services.
acceptanceCriteria: Outputs match the target-only deterministic decoder
Rejection and end-of-sequence cases terminate correctly
tasks.verification: Run the harness's independent Python unittest decoding checks with fixed token sequences; preserve decode(draft_tokens, target_tokens, eos=0). Do not infer production speedup from stubs.

tasks.title: Bound dynamic batching waits
tasks.instructions: Add fake-clock tests for batch size limits, timeout flush and request cancellation. Preserve request ordering and prevent small requests from waiting forever.
acceptanceCriteria: Batches respect size and wait limits
Cancelled requests are omitted without dropping live requests
tasks.verification: Run independent Python unittest checks for flush(requests, now, max_size, max_wait), returning (selected IDs, remaining request dictionaries). Requests have id, enqueued and optional cancelled fields.

fixture.acceptanceScript:
import unittest
from router.batch import flush
class BatchTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_wait_and_timeout(self):
        requests = [{'id':'a','enqueued':0}]
        self.assertEqual(flush(requests, 2, 4, 5), ([], requests))
        self.assertEqual(flush(requests, 5, 4, 5), (['a'], []))
    def test_limit_order_and_cancellation(self):
        requests = [{'id':'cancel','enqueued':0,'cancelled':True}] + [{'id':str(i),'enqueued':0} for i in range(5)]
        chosen, remaining = flush(requests, 10, 2, 5)
        self.assertEqual(chosen, ['0','1'])
        self.assertEqual([r['id'] for r in remaining], ['2','3','4'])
        self.assertEqual(len(requests), 6)
    def test_empty(self):
        self.assertEqual(flush([], 100, 2, 5), ([], []))
unittest.main()

tasks.title: Verify sensor wire-format boundaries
tasks.instructions: Add host-side frame encoding tests for byte order, maximum payloads and truncated buffers. Preserve the existing wire format and reject overflow before writing.
acceptanceCriteria: Boundary values encode to expected bytes
Short buffers fail without partial out-of-bounds writes
tasks.verification: Run the harness's host rustc --test acceptance checks without external crates, hardware or network. Preserve encode(seq: u16, payload: &[u8], out: &mut [u8]) -> Result<usize, &'static str>; frame is little-endian seq, u8 payload length, payload.

tasks.title: Check idle sampling scheduling
tasks.instructions: Test the sensor-frame scheduling boundary with a fake clock: idle intervals should not emit duplicate UDP frames, and active sampling should resume without losing the next frame. Avoid new hardware dependencies.
acceptanceCriteria: Idle intervals do not emit duplicate frames
tasks.verification: Run the harness's host rustc --test checks for should_emit(last_ms: Option<u64>, now_ms: u64, interval_ms: u64, active: bool) -> bool. No power-savings claim without hardware measurements.
